title: PyTorch: model returns probabilities but the loss expects logits
goal: Reproduce the documented experiment and determine why the validation accuracy does not match the documented result. Fix the repository so it reproduces the documented result.

ground_truth.description: MLP.forward applies softmax, then CrossEntropyLoss applies log-softmax again, so the gradients are tiny and the model barely learns.

fix.search:
import torch
from torch import nn

notes: REAL PyTorch on CPU. Needs the PyPI torch wheel (about 5 GB installed on Linux x86-64 with the CUDA runtime bundled, several minutes to install); it runs on the CPU and needs no GPU. Installing its requirements is the only large download in the benchmark.
